contract: Two Tone A/B levels are independent; Noise adds white-noise content. Named components do not define synthesis or RNG implementation.
Filter adjusts high-pass/band-pass cutoff and higher settings increase high-frequency content; no filter curve is given.
Clave enables Repeat for clave repetitions.
Pitch changes pitch, Decay sound length and Volume overall level; upper-half display click previews current settings.
Sloppy changes spacing of panned clap delay lines; Tail adds filtered noise. Exact impulse/delay/noise law is not specified.
Spread 0% is mono and 100% widened stereo; Tone higher increases high-frequency content.
Tune sets pitch, Decay sound length and Volume level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Cymbal source includes sine/pulse and high-passed noise; Tone raises high-pass cutoff. Names provide no waveform or noise tolerance.
Pitch, Decay and Volume adjust pitch, length and overall level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Tone sets low-pass cutoff; Feedb. controls FM feedback with more noise at higher values. No feedback transfer law or alias bound is supplied.
Amnt controls FM depth; Mod blends modulation types, whose exact identities/law are unspecified.
Pitch is global pitch, Decay sound length and Volume overall level.
Upper-half display click previews sound at current settings.
Hat combines noise/sine; Noise selects white or pink.
Tone sets high-pass cutoff; pitched portion uses resonant high-pass with 12/24 dB slope choices and Attack.
Pitch is global pitch, Decay sound length and Volume level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Pitch is in Hz; Drive adds distortion and OT harmonics to modulated-sine kick.
Attack smooths sine onset; Click adds transient.
Decay controls length, Env pitch modulation, Volume level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Color changes pitched-oscillator tone; Tone controls noise presence.
Noise filter choices are low-pass, high-pass and band-pass.
Decay adjusts length, Tune global pitch and Volume overall level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Pitch is Hz; Color controls filter gain/cutoff, Tone level of resonant band-pass filters.
Bend adjusts pitch envelope, Decay length and Volume level.
Upper-half display click previews current settings.
Dated Version 12: load owned sample by dropping on upper display; Start changes sample start and Length playback length. Current HTML omits this profile; exact target availability/behavior U.
Dated Version 12: Tune spans -48 to +48 semitones; Loop toggles sample looping. No pitch/resampling/loop-boundary formula follows.
Dated Version 12: Decay controls sample amplitude decay, Shaper distortion and Volume overall level.
Delay Mode choices Time, Samples and Distance use ms, samples and meters/feet. No time-distance-speed or sample-rounding law is supplied.
Distance supports Temperature with Celsius/Fahrenheit choice and temperature slider.
Link L/R applies left settings to right; right slider is grayed and left edits both.
Map then parameter click assigns target; Multimap exposes up to eight mappings and Unmap removes selected assignment.

Modulation permits manual base-value edits with Bipolar centered/Unipolar one-direction depth; Remote Control owns mapped value and prevents manual edit, with Min/Max range. Documentary default Modulation is not a target constructor proof.
Input amplitude produces mapped envelope; Gain controls input level and Rise/Fall smooth attack/release.
Envelope Delay supports time and synchronized beat divisions.
Expanded Audio Routing and Sidechain select external track plus Pre FX/Post FX/Post Mixer and Rack channel; Direct/S.C. meters show respective inputs.
Sidechain Mix 0% uses track input only; 100% external donor only for envelope generation.
Map then parameter click assigns target; Multimap exposes up to eight mappings and Unmap removes selected assignment.

Modulation permits manual base-value edits with Bipolar centered/Unipolar one-direction depth; Remote Control owns mapped value and prevents manual edit, with Min/Max range. Documentary default Modulation is not a target constructor proof.
Nine waves: Sine, Up, Down, Triangle, Square, Random, Bin, Stray, Glider. Shape unavailable for Random/Bin/Stray/Glider; Steps unavailable for Random/Bin/Square; Steps up to 24.
Jitter randomizes output; Smooth softens output changes including jitter.
Rate uses Hz or beat divisions; Hz permits ×10. Depth 0% applies no modulation,100% maximum.
Offset centers at 0 and shifts output upward/downward; Phase spans 0-100% cycle.
Hold freezes current LFO output; release restarts from held value. R retriggers at Phase position.
Map then parameter click assigns target; Multimap exposes up to eight mappings and Unmap removes selected assignment.

Modulation permits manual base-value edits with Bipolar centered/Unipolar one-direction depth; Remote Control owns mapped value and prevents manual edit, with Min/Max range. Documentary default Modulation is not a target constructor proof.
Breakpoint envelope generates mapping data. Click creates, Alt Win/Option Mac segment drag curves, Shift-click deletes; Clear removes envelope; six presets replace it.
Grid controls divisions and Snap moves created/repositioned points to nearest line; small display shows output.
Jitter randomizes, Smooth softens output, Offset shifts center relative to0.
Phase spans 0-100%; R retriggers at Phase and is disabled in Sync time mode.
Trigger modes Loop continuously at Rate,1-Shot via mappable T, Manual scrub control; Rate Hz/sync. Depth 0 none,100 maximum.
Map then parameter click assigns target; Multimap exposes up to eight mappings and Unmap removes selected assignment.

Modulation permits manual base-value edits with Bipolar centered/Unipolar one-direction depth; Remote Control owns mapped value and prevents manual edit, with Min/Max range. Documentary default Modulation is not a target constructor proof.
ADSR mapping modes Free(note), Sync(division), Loop(Global Time), Echo(Time/Feedback); LED flashes each trigger.
Global Time1.00 matches ADSR timing; above stretches/below compresses proportionally. Amount 0 none,100 maximum.
Attack/Decay/Sustain/Release and ADR Slope edit by values or display; Release returns envelope to0 after note release.
Velocity toggle scales envelope peak with incoming velocity.
Sustain on holds level while note held then Release; off is one-shot Attack/Decay/Release regardless held duration.
Five source tabs each select Velocity, Modwheel, Pitchbend, Pressure, Keytrack, Expression, Random, Increment, Slide, Sustain; Map then target click assigns selected source.
Modulate permits base edits and bipolar/unipolar ranges; Remote owns parameter and exposes Min/Max. Modulate OutputRange Max represents maximum input.
Linear curve has two points/Curve A; S-curve three, upperA/lowerB and linked inverse editing viaA; Min/Max and S-middleX/Y can edit with display.
Increment activates1-32Steps per cycle; Stop resets count so first note after restart outputs configured minimum.
Random activates Amount and changes deviation each note trigger; no stream/seed/distribution guaranteed.
Smoothing chooses linear/logarithmic; Rise/Fall times0-1000ms reach new rising/falling value.
Dated Version 12: Velocity, ModulationWheel, PitchBend, Aftertouch and Keytrack each map to one destination via Map then target click. This is Legacy, not current ten-source/five-tab device.
Dated Version 12: each mapping has independent Min/Max intensity and Log/Lin shape.
Dated Version 12: Rise/Fall smooth envelope attack/release; Output displays per-mapping output.
Dated Version 12 says Live 11 Sets containing Expression Control load renamed Expression Control Legacy. Exact target migration and all-version parity remain U.
Note view displays incoming notes, root/related chords on keyboard and velocity; chord recognition rules not specified.
Flow lists incoming notes and controller data continuously; Freeze pauses/unpauses display and Clear empties it.
MPE view lists incoming note, velocity, slide, pressure and per-note pitch streams.
Press, Slide, NotePB sources independently enable and transform MPE; source selection foregrounds curve. Documented default sources on is not constructor proof.
Linear(two points) or S(three) curves allow Min/Max, Curve and display editing; S middle X/Y and unlinkable two segment controls.
Advanced panel exposes per-source Smooth and independent Rise/Fall plus source-dependent options.
Press Default supplies value to non-MPE notes; Swap to Slide redirects pressure; Press to AT converts to monophonic aftertouch.
Slide CC74 offers Default, Centered and Abs/Rel/Ons. Rel starts midrange and changes with subsequent sweep; Ons updates only at Note On and disables smoothing.
Slide to Mod converts to ModWheel CC1 for non-MPE instruments.
NotePB Pitch Range adjusts controller/instrument range relationship; manual gives2x for ±48 controller/±24 instrument. NotePB to PB converts to standard pitch bend.
Creates MIDI note echoes with decreasing velocity; Sync divisions count sixteenths(4=quarter); off usesms; DelayTime percentage adjusts fraction.
Input Thru passes original plus echoes;Mute removes original leaving echoes.
Pitch transposes each repeat;Delay controls echo velocity and Fback return amount.
MPE on echoes incoming expression with notes;off filters MPE. On enables Press/Slide/NotePBfeedback;below100% progressively decays repeatedMPE.

MIDI notes trigger envelope;click creates point, Ctrl Win/Cmd Mac creates only one sustain point, Alt/Option curves, Shift-click deletes;Clear and six presets available. Sustainpoint holds while note held.
Grid/Snap nearestline editing;small outputdisplay andtriggerLED.
Jitter randomizes, Smooth softens, Offset sets center shift around 0.
Velocity 0% has no velocity effect;larger values scale lower/higher note velocities down/up.
Loop repeats while note held at Rate and bypasses sustain point;Rate Hz/sync;Depth 0 none,100 maximum.
Echo feedback control governs envelope repetitions;Time sets echo interval.
